notes.title: BLUE RIDER - Big Update!
notes.notes:
- Original Soundtrack available... for FREE!
- Bosses are still bad-asses; but they'll reward you better from now on (+50% of power-ups droppings!).
- Improved overall performance and minor bug-fixes.
- 100% positive reviews warranty!

notes.title: Blue Rider Update: Bug Fixing and Performance
notes.notes:
Thanks to the collaboration of the community, we have improved game performance and we have also fixed some bugs.

Bug Fixing:

 - Some achievements are not triggered properly.
 - Textures on level 4.
 
Performance fixes:

 - Shadow quality was improved.
 - Amount of particles used in explosions.
 - Fixed: Lag in several simultaneously explosions
 - New water resolution for medium and low qualities.
